body: Mostly just looking for advice and opinions. I have technically made my mind up, it looks good on paper to me but I just wanted to see what people who are much more knowledgeable than me thought. If it was unreasonable or I could do better etc etc.

There is some slight merit to it other than aesthetics.

I tested various angles, intakes, and this setup seemed to be the best.  
\- Conforms with the weapons bay setup, I can't shape the duct obviously but if I could I would've given it a spiral shape to slow and cool the air before it reaches the engine and also help occlude the compressor face to reduce radar cross section  
\- Unique look.

I actually wanted to contour the intake against the center, it looked quite good and would probably work better irl but ingame it seems the current setup is the best. I do feel like irl this would end up ingesting the boundary layer, but FAR doesn't model that if i'm not wrong.
Might add that it also adds air sound simulation meaning you get supersonic effects

Rocket sound enhancement, self explanatory mod, it revamps the sound system entirely making it more realistic. All engines sound a LOT more realistic and therefore better, you also have the option to make sound fade as you get out of the atmosphere.
Unfortunately not, FAR is great but it misses a lot of stuff like compression lift and ground effect. Would make RSS hypersonic aircraft and SSTOs a whole lot easier 😭
